==Description==
'''E-60''' will be the 4th entity you will encounter in [[Section E]] and was one of the Invasive entities present during the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]]. More info shown below.

==Mechanics==
<tabber>
|-|Current=
'''Current''':<br>When '''E-60''' spawns, it will begin to rush to the main room at Moderate speed, filling the players screen with static when nearby to warn them to hide immediately, then smash into the door, breaking it down and despawning, immediately respawning far ahead and staying idle. '''E-60''' will begin to rush backwards after around 4 seconds or if the door is opened, when it does rush backwards, it will start filling the player's screen with static, breaking the door and falling back quickly, truly despawning past Voidwall.

If a player dies or gets locker sniped by '''E-60''' while it is rushing to the door, it Will Break 1 locker in each room when falling back, this being indicated by [[Oblivion]] marking lockers with an X.

|-|Old=
'''Old''':<br>When '''E-60''' spawns, it will begin to rush to the main room at Moderate speeds, emmiting very quiet sounds, when it hits the door, it will break it no matter what, then it will place itself behind the next rooms door and go silent, tho leaving small amounts of static on the players screen, after 4~ seconds it will start playing its Ambience again, breaking the door down after 3 seconds(2 if in [[Red Rooms]]) and rushing backwards at Moderate speed, despawning past voidwall.
</tabber>

==Strategies & Tips==
* after it hits the door, you should exit your locker, and Reenter after 3 seconds.

* if an entity breaks the door While '''E-60''' is behind it, it will cause him to immediately backtrack, so if you hear an entity that is able of breaking the door while '''E-60''' is active, do not exit your locker.

* if you are in [[Red Rooms]] and '''E-60''' is already behind the door, rehide earlier, since '''E-60''' will give you less time to react.

* [https://youtu.be/ALWnpI7xza0?si=jj9kmGkIeib-DmHt Current behavior Representation]
* [https://youtu.be/TqbnnePI3eo?si=YDbnZZwaUh9mq8v5 Old Behavior Representation]

==Trivia==
* '''E-60''' has a chance to rush to the main room without its far sound.
** '''E-60''' will start play its close sound from further away, giving you bit more time to react and hide if this happens.
* '''E-60''''s old faces originate from the roblox marketplace.
** These were removed from the game due to the user who uploaded them having stolen them.
*** '''E-60''' Used [[A-60i]]'s Old Design as a Placeholder for the rest of the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]] due to this.
* '''E-60''' was one of the two Invasive entities present during the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]], the other being [[E-10]].
* '''E-60''' is the slowest 60 entity.
